name: Wave:3
author: abduldotdev
description: Keeps an Elgato Wave:3 USB microphone as the default input and adds a bar widget with a controls popup: hardware gain, mute, headphone volume, monitor blend, Clipguard, low cut, gain lock, LEDs, and a live level meter. One-click Set up in the popup links a WirePlumber rule and starts a watcher. Those setup files are written only after you click Set up.

barWidget.description: Elgato Wave:3 status and hardware controls, with one-click setup in the popup and a right-click reset
